sketchMechanisms: The Maybe monad's >>= (bind) operator silently propagates Nothing through a chain of computations, so once any step yields Nothing, every subsequent step is skipped without error.
In Erlang, a process can link to another process, and when one dies, the linked process also dies unless it traps exits — but trapping exits converts death into a message, not into shared fate.
A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no matching row exists on the right, filling the right side with NULL — the absent partner is represented but empty.
